product.name: Ben Martin Men's Bell Bottom Jeans
product.description: Ben Martin men's retro bell-bottom jeans featuring a high-rise waist, wide flared leg and regular fit. Made from cotton denim with a stretchable construction for comfortable movement and a distinctive retro look.

review_summary.summary: Customers generally like the jeans for their styling, comfort and value for money. However, feedback is mixed on length, sizing, stitching, color durability and hardware quality.
positive: Several customers report good or excellent fitting
Available across a broad size range
Suitable for college and casual styling
negative: Some customers report weak hook/button quality
review_summary.main_concern: Consistency. Many buyers consider the jeans good value, but reviews indicate that fit, length, stitching and color durability can vary.

fit.note: Several reviews report excellent or comfortable fitting, but at least one verified buyer reported that the actual fitting did not match the product images.

comfort.note: Customers describe the jeans as comfortable, and the product is marketed with stretchable construction and a relaxed/roomy silhouette.

fabric_quality.note: Several customers praise the fabric and quality for the price, while another reviewer described the fabric as relatively thin.

style.note: The retro bell-bottom/wide-leg design is consistently positioned as a major feature.

value_for_money.note: Value for money is one of the most frequently mentioned positive themes.

color_durability.note: One verified customer specifically reported that the black color faded within 3–4 washes, while the overall review summary also flags fading as a recurring concern.

length.note: The source's customer summary says several customers consider the length too short.

stitching.note: Some customers praise stitching while others report improper stitching.

hardware.note: A verified buyer reported that the hook/button felt loose and poor quality.

cons: Not suitable for customers wanting a conventional straight/slim silhouette

best_for: Customers wanting an affordable flared jean
Customers who want stretch and comfort
not_ideal_for: Customers who need extremely precise sizing
buying_advice.size_advice: The listing provides sizes 28–40, but customer feedback on sizing and length is mixed. Recommend checking the size chart and, where possible, comparing waist and length measurements with an existing pair of jeans.
buying_advice.color_advice: The local catalog contains Black, Dark Blue, Green, Khaki and Light Blue images. The product source also lists Dark Blue, Light Blue, Grey, Black and White as available colors, so use the local image filenames as the actual catalog variants rather than adding unsupported colors.
buying_advice.quality_advice: Do not market this as premium denim despite the product description using the phrase 'premium denim'. Customer feedback is mixed, with strong value-for-money sentiment but complaints about fading, stitching, material thickness and hardware.
buying_advice.sales_advice: Lead with the distinctive bell-bottom silhouette, high-rise fit, wide flare, stretchable cotton denim, five pockets, broad size range and ₹924 price. Style is the stronger selling proposition than durability.
buying_advice.review_advice: If a customer asks whether it is reliable, give a balanced answer: the 3.9 rating and many positive reviews support the product, but mention that some buyers reported fading, length/sizing problems and hardware quality concerns.

shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_product: Describe this as a retro high-rise bell-bottom/wide-leg jean with a flared silhouette, stretchable cotton denim, five pockets and sizes 28–40.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_if_good: Recommend it for customers who specifically want a retro/wide-leg style and good value. Mention the 3.9 rating but also disclose the mixed feedback around sizing, length and fading.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_fit: Explain that the official fit is regular, the rise is high and the leg is wide/flared. Because customer feedback on sizing is mixed, recommend checking the size chart.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_quality: Give a balanced answer. Several customers praise the quality, fabric and value, while others report thin material, stitching issues and weak hardware.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_color: The local catalog contains Black, Dark Blue, Green, Khaki and Light Blue. A verified review specifically says the Green variant looked like the pictures, while another review reports Black fading after 3–4 washes.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_comfort: Mention the stretchable construction and roomy wide-leg silhouette. Multiple customers report comfortable wear.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_reviews: Explain that the product has a 3.9/5 rating from 1,470 global ratings, with 51% 5-star, 21% 4-star, 9% 3-star, 5% 2-star and 14% 1-star ratings.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_sizing: The product supports sizes 28–40 according to the product description, while the captured size selector displays 28–38. Recommend checking current availability and the size chart.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_price: The captured listing price is ₹924 against an MRP of ₹2,999, representing a 69% discount.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_daily_wear: Recommend it for casual, college, weekend and statement outfits. It is more style-focused than a conventional everyday straight jean.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_value: Value for money is one of the strongest themes in the customer feedback.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_durability: Do not guarantee long-term color durability. Customer feedback includes a report of black color fading after 3–4 washes.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_for_alternatives: If the customer wants a conventional silhouette, recommend straight or regular-fit jeans instead. If they specifically want retro flared styling, this is a strong candidate.
